title: The Last Thorn Again
author: Gideon Ashgrove
blurb: Jude Thornbury, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
